description:
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {2}{U}, targeting any two permanents.
Holding priority, activate Mana Vault by tapping it, adding {3}.
Activate Lithoform Engine's second ability by paying {3} and tapping it, copying Ghostly Flicker, with the copy targeting Mana Vault and Lithoform Engine.
Resolve the copy of Ghostly Flicker, blinking Mana Vault and Lithoform Engine.
Repeat from step 2.
